scripts.build: pnpm --filter @kudu/shared build && pnpm --filter @kudu/frontend build && pnpm --filter @kudu/backend build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @kudu/shared build && pnpm --filter @kudu/shared typecheck && pnpm --filter @kudu/backend typecheck && pnpm --filter @kudu/frontend typecheck
scripts.db:migrate: pnpm --filter @kudu/shared build && pnpm --filter @kudu/backend build && pnpm --filter @kudu/backend migrate
scripts.desktop:dev: pnpm run desktop:build:renderer && pnpm --dir desktop run dev
scripts.desktop:package:deb: pnpm run desktop:build:renderer && pnpm --dir desktop run package:deb
scripts.desktop:package:appimage: pnpm run desktop:build:renderer && pnpm --dir desktop run package:appimage
scripts.desktop:package:linux: pnpm run desktop:build:renderer && pnpm --dir desktop run package:linux
